titleId.description: Unique homebrew title ID; do not reuse an installed application ID.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after first frame until closure; 0 disables the timeout.

refreshRate.description: Display refresh in Hz. 120 needs a display with 120 Hz input; others stay at 60.

refreshRates.description: Rates Display.setRefreshRate may switch to while the app runs; must include refreshRate. Defaults to refreshRate alone.

resolution.description: Instead of render and surface: build 1920x1080 and 3840x2160 layouts and pick the one matching the console's output at launch (1440p uses 3840x2160).

filesystemAccess.description: console packages the pinned Lapy helper and requests filesystem access at startup; requires local elfldr on port 9021 or resident Lapy.

networking.description: Enable native HTTP and large-file downloads; PS5 requires filesystemAccess: console. Desktop networking is available independently.

userAgent.description: User-Agent sent with every native HTTP request: printable ASCII, 1..128 characters.

resources.description: Relative files or directories copied read-only into the application folder. No symlinks, traversal or package-infrastructure paths.

textFonts.description: Scripts whose subset Noto font is packaged in fonts/ and shaped and rasterized at runtime when text needs it: chinese (GB 2312), japanese (JIS X 0208), devanagari (Hindi), bengali, arabic (Arabic and Urdu). See docs/TEXT.md.

video.description: Plays video with <Video> (FFmpeg demuxing and decoding). Adds about 16 MB to the PS5 build; streams over http(s) also need networking.

source.description: A C source in the app folder, relative to it.

name.description: The .elf it is built into, in the app folder.

payloads.description: The app's own payloads for the console's payload loader, built with the PS5 Payload SDK like the engine's updater.elf and shipped in the app folder (Payloads.send('/app0/<name>')).
